MonitorExtendInfo.description_en:
The extended information. This includes the parameters required for health checks of different protocols:

HTTP(S):

port: Health Check Port.
host: the host setting.
path: the URL path.
code: the return code threshold.
failureRate: the failure rate.
sni: specifies whether to enable SNI. This parameter applies only to the HTTPS protocol.
    - true: enabled.
    - false: disabled.
nodeType: the type of the health check monitoring node when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:
    - IPV4
    - IPV6

PING:

failureRate: the failure rate.
packetNum: the number of ping packets.
packetLossRate: the ping packet loss rate.
nodeType: the type of the health check monitoring node when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:
    - IPV4
    - IPV6

TCP:

port: Health Check Port.
failureRate: the failure rate.
nodeType: the type of the health check monitoring node when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:
    - IPV4
    - IPV6
